# Color Contrast Analysis Report

## 1. Critical Contrast Issues Identified

### **Primary Issue: Secondary Text on Green Background**
**Location:** Main content card (green gradient background)
- **Problem Text:** The paragraph starting with *"Halo **Raka Pratama**! Teruslah bertanya..."*
- **Colors Involved:** Light gray/white text (#E0E0E0 or similar) on medium-to-dark green background (#1B8A6F to #0D5C4A)
- **Severity:** **MODERATE** - While readable for users with normal vision, this fails WCAG AA standards (requires 4.5:1 ratio for normal text). The light gray color blends into the green background, especially for users with visual impairments or in bright lighting conditions.

### **Secondary Issue: Metadata Text**
**Location:** Top of the green card
- **Problem Text:** *"Sapaan Mentor • pukul 16.29 WIB"*
- **Colors Involved:** Very light gray/white on green background
- **Severity:** **LOW-MODERATE** - Small text size combined with low contrast makes this difficult to read quickly.

## 2. Specific UI Elements with Contrast Problems

| Element | Text Content | Foreground Color | Background Color | Issue |
|---------|-------------|------------------|------------------|-------|
| **Card Subtitle** | "Sapaan Mentor • pukul 16.29 WIB" | Light Gray (#CCCCCC approx) | Green Gradient | Low contrast, small font size |
| **Body Paragraph** | "Halo Raka Pratama! Teruslah..." | Light Gray/Off-white | Green Gradient | Insufficient contrast ratio (~3.5:1 estimated) |
| **Button Placeholder** | [Empty input field] | White/Light | White/Light | Appears washed out (though may be intentional placeholder) |

## 3. Elements with GOOD Contrast (Reference)
- **Main Heading:** "Selamat sore Raka!" - **Excellent** contrast (bold white on green)
- **Navigation Bar:** Dark text on cream background - **Good** contrast
- **"Beranda" Button:** White text on dark green - **Excellent** contrast
- **XP Progress Bar:** Visible contrast between filled/empty states

## 4. Overall Contrast Quality Rating: **6.5/10**

### Summary:
The application uses a generally accessible color scheme, but the **green content card has a critical flaw**: the body text and metadata use colors that are too similar to the background. 

**Recommendations:**
1. **Increase body text brightness** to pure white (#FFFFFF) or near-white (#F5F5F5)
2. **Darken the green background** slightly or use a text shadow for better separation
3. **Increase font weight** of the secondary paragraph text
4. **Add subtle text shadows** (`text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)`) to improve legibility without changing colors

**WCAG Compliance Status:** Currently fails AA standards for the body text section; would pass with the recommended adjustments above.
